findings.title: Roadmap isolation violation: Phase number 100500 embedded in test names and module comments
findings.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/provider_adapter_tests.rs:11 (//! - Unit and integration tests for import_provider (T100500-01 through T100500-04)), crates/clio-mcp/src/provider_adapter_tests.rs:149,202,258,306 (fn t100500_01_*, fn t100500_02_*, fn t100500_03_*, fn t100500_04_*), crates/clio-mcp/src/provider_adapter_edge_tests.rs:10-12 (//! - Security tests (credential masking T100500-05)), and crates/clio-mcp/src/provider_adapter_edge_tests.rs:27,67,93 (fn t100500_05_*, fn t100500_06_*, fn t100500_07_*)
findings.requirement_ref: AGENTS.md §'Private / Public Boundary' ('Never reference private/... paths in any public file... Never paste private file contents (requirement text, roadmap phases, worker prompts, run logs) into public files') and Developer Hard Rules ('Roadmap isolation: never reference private/clio-private/roadmap/, phase numbers, or roadmap files from code or comments')
findings.recommendation: Rename test functions and update doc comments in provider_adapter_tests.rs and provider_adapter_edge_tests.rs to standard ordinal prefixes (e.g. t01_*, t02_*, etc.) without mentioning the private phase number 100500.

findings.title: Dry-run and live-run intra-batch deduplication divergence
findings.requirement_ref: requirement.md FR-29 / §4.9.5.B ('JSON import SHALL be idempotent by default... and SHALL support a dry-run report with zero writes. When a provider adapter is implemented... SHALL offer the same dry-run report before writing.')
findings.recommendation: Track encountered external IDs in an in-memory HashSet during the import_provider_mem0 loop so that duplicate IDs in a single pull response are counted as would_skip rather than would_create during dry_run, maintaining exact parity with live execution.

plan_1hr: Rename t100500_* test functions and remove phase number references from provider_adapter_tests.rs and provider_adapter_edge_tests.rs to restore roadmap isolation.
Add a local HashSet<String> of seen external IDs to import_provider_mem0 in provider_adapter.rs so that duplicates within a dry-run pull correctly count as would_skip.
plan_unlimited: Add provider adapters for the remaining four external memory systems (hindsight, mnemosyne, honcho, supermemory) using the validated Mem0 adapter pattern.
Support configurable query filters (e.g. time range, categories) in provider options mapped to external provider search/list endpoints.
